test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A guard observes an enemy boat, from an observation tower at a height of 180 meters above the sea level, to be at an angle of depression of 60°. What is the distance of the boat from the foot of the tower?
solution:
**Given:**

Height of the observation tower = 180 m 

Angle of depression = 60° 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dadc69f143a3cccc78343c1a34ded7f562ded8b76fbe15f5cd027ca0ecae490.png] 

In triangle ABC, AB/BC = tan 60° 

⇒ 180/a = √3

⇒ √3a = 180 

⇒ a = 180/√3 × √3/√3

⇒ a = 60√3 

**∴ The distance of the boat from the foot of the tower is 60√3 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94d1088cd59c15eeb7599a373f73ef62464f3adcc91723252959873d0a1fdc42.png] 

Here, √3 = 180 

⇒ 1 = 180/√3

**∴ 1 = 180/√3 × √3/√3 = 60√3 m **
